packageRules.description: third_party/ holds unpacked crates.io releases patched for collaboration (#1043; third_party/README.md). Their manifests mirror the upstream release, and their dev-dependencies are never built by the workspace, so a bump there proves nothing and drifts the vendored copy from the release it names. Update them by re-vendoring.

Hold the GitHub-hosted runner at ubuntu-24.04. On ubuntu-26.04 (#872) the GUI smoke suite fails wholesale: dogtail stops finding the apps' push buttons over AT-SPI ('New Document', 'Close', 'Add sheet'), and test_gui_harness.py's process-ownership test kills a process it did not start. Moving runners is a migration of the GUI harness, not a version bump. Remove this rule in the PR that makes the suite pass on 26.04.

Keep the Lifafa CI container on a released Fedora. docker.io/library/fedora:46 is Rawhide (its dnf installs from the rawhide repo) until Fedora 46 ships in spring 2027; #2092 ran the Lifafa job on it and it failed. Raise the bound to <47 when Fedora 46 is released.
Hold the rdocx family at 0.16.2 until the Letters adapters support 0.16.3, and group the eventual upgrade so incompatible partial updates are not proposed (#1725).
Lifafa (lifafa/, its own lock): html5ever and markup5ever_rcdom move together, because RcDom implements only its own html5ever release's TreeSink, so a lone html5ever bump does not build (#2060).

Lifafa's toolkit moves as one, with its relm4: gtk4 0.9, libadwaita 0.7, webkit6 0.4, pangocairo 0.20 and cairo-rs 0.20 belong together (relm4 0.9 requires gtk4 0.9, and a newer cairo-rs is a second cairo whose surfaces the toolkit cannot draw). A lone bump of any of them does not build. They move in the relm4 replacement (#2025); until then Renovate proposes none of them.
Lifafa's IMAP worker uses imap-proto types that async-imap 0.12 reshaped; hold at 0.10 until the worker is ported (#1986).

Lifafa's mail reader, PGP path and attachment renderer use mail-parser 0.9's part offsets and charset decoders, which 0.11 changed (u32 offsets, private decoders); hold until that port lands as its own change (#2066).

Never automerge in lifafa/. Its build job is path-filtered, so it is not a required check, and an automerged bump can land red: #2060, #2066 and #2067 did. A person merges Lifafa updates once that job is green.

The p2panda crates move as one: tools/collab-spike/dcp-p2p pins all six at one version, so a lone bump never resolves. 0.8 reshapes the store, spaces and signing APIs the binding uses; hold below it until the port (#2084).
